topics.title: Cancellation of non-abelian multiple Glauber insertions in inclusive Drell–Yan (and its TMD version), as general as possible
topics.goal: Prove, under explicitly stated hypotheses and for as general a class as possible, the cancellation of MULTIPLE NON-ABELIAN Glauber exchanges in inclusive Drell–Yan at leading power: arbitrary numbers N of Glauber insertions between the two hadrons' jets/spectators, non-commuting colour generators in arbitrary representations, arbitrary remnant colour states, both uncut and cut (real-emission) direct spectator–spectator lines (OPEN-13 of the X1 report), the central (Lipatov three-gluon-vertex) emissions needed for current conservation at O(g^6) (P5), three-line unitarity (OPEN-9), and the half-coincident residual proportional to ∫ Im W12 ⟨ψ|i[X1,X2]|ψ⟩ (show that it cancels after the complete sum over graphs/cuts or remnant states, or establish a genuine non-cancellation, which would have to be verified to the highest standard). Determine precisely: what can be proved at all orders (theorem with hypotheses), what at fixed order (O(g^4), O(g^6), O(g^8)), what in models (scalar spectator model M_glob of X1, eikonal/Wilson-line limit), and what remains open; and the consequences for the monograph's statements thm:appO-main, thm:dy-factorization, lem:dy-fsi, prop:dy-deformation, asm:appO-mixing(c), asm:appO-deformation, prop:appO-tmd, lem:tmd-glauber (TMD Drell–Yan: the same questions with measured q_T; past-pointing Wilson-line staples).

approaches: Light-cone-ordered perturbation theory with colour-ordered unitarity: extend the X1 machinery (joint localization L1, ordering weights, side sums, commuting-insertion theorem T1) to non-commuting colour operators. Represent the Glauber-region contribution of N spectator–spectator exchanges as a light-cone-time-ordered product of colour-operator-valued eikonal factors (a time-ordered Glauber evolution operator U); use completeness over the final remnant states, the unitarity U†U = 1 and the position of the hard vertex in light-cone time to make the cut sum telescope; treat active–spectator exchanges by contour deformation; identify every obstruction (ordering relative to V_H, instantaneous terms, cut direct lines, central emissions) and prove or disprove its cancellation. Aim for an all-order theorem [R, R_cond] with explicit hypotheses.

Glauber soft-collinear effective theory (Rothstein–Stewart): Glauber operators coupling n-collinear, n̄-collinear and soft sectors, the Glauber collapse rule, exponentiation of the Glauber phase for forward n–n̄ scattering with the rapidity regulator and zero-bin subtractions. Prove, conditionally on stated EFT assumptions (leading-power completeness of the mode set, rapidity regularization, absence of extra pinches), that all Glauber contributions cancel in the inclusive Drell–Yan cross section to all orders at leading power (spectator–spectator phases cancel by unitarity; active–spectator ones are absorbed into Wilson-line directions), for collinear and TMD Drell–Yan; then relate each EFT statement precisely to the full-theory LCOPT statements of the X1 report (which hypotheses of X1 the EFT argument assumes, which it proves).

Explicit higher-order verification: compute exactly, with full non-abelian colour algebra (SU(N), generators in arbitrary representations, real and complex remnant colour states), the cut sums of three Glauber exchanges (O(g^6)) and, where feasible, four (O(g^8)), in (i) the eikonal/Wilson-line limit of the spectators and (ii) the scalar spectator model M_glob of the X1 report with LCOPT jets; include cut (real-emission) direct lines and the central Lipatov emission; test the conjectured all-order cancellation identities of the other strategies and the half-coincident residual; find and characterize any non-cancelling term (and whether it is power-suppressed, cancels after the remnant-state sum, or survives). Produce exact formulas, verified symbolically and numerically, and a precise table of what cancels where.
